svg.title: Trace data pipeline
svg.desc: The Harness session, collected in a container or imported from this machine, is copied to trace.jsonl and converted to trace_ACTF.json, which yields trace_SFT.json and sft.jsonl. roller export redacts the sessions into a Hugging Face dataset and converts the trace to ATIF. --capture-calls enables compaction segments and --wire-trace full keeps request bodies in wire_trace.jsonl.
